query:
SELECT 
  p.id,
  p.name,
  COUNT(pc.id) as num_compositions
FROM products p
LEFT JOIN productCompositions pc ON p.id = pc.parentProductId
WHERE p.isComposite = 1
GROUP BY p.id, p.name
ORDER BY p.id
